modules.name: Dragon Academy
modules.note: Its cards, guilds, objectives and round tracker merge into the base game permanently.

steps.text: Dragon Guild board with 1 random Dragon Guild tile, side for your player count up
Shuffle the dragons; {n} faceup on the card display, deck beside it
Shuffle the cave cards; {n} faceup on the card display, deck beside it
Round marker on Round 1; {n} random objective tiles, random side up, on the round tracker
Solo: redraw the "Position on Dragon Guild" objective if it comes up
Coins, eggs and all tokens in a public supply
Training tokens within reach
Each player: a player mat and all pieces of one color (adventurer, 8 markers, guild token)
Each player gains {n} coins, 1 egg, 3 dragons, 3 caves and 3 resources of their choice
Keep 4 of your 6 cards in any mix; discard the other 2
Your egg on one of the 2 nest icons on your mat
Coins left of your mat; adventurer in Base Camp; guild token on the Dragon Guild's START space
Automa's guild token on the Dragon Guild START space; 1 of her markers beside the guild board
1 Automa marker between each round on the round tracker; her other 4 markers beside it
Build the 8-card decision deck for your difficulty; set 1 aside unseen, shuffle the rest facedown
End of each of your turns: discard down to 9 coins, 9 cards and 9 resources
Once you pass, you take no more turns this round
When you pass, place your adventurer on the round tracker to choose your income
Random player gets the start player marker; play is clockwise
You start every round
Each turn: excavate, entice a dragon, or explore a cave - or pass
